A.dependence_on_k: explicit 1/k normalization; A2 also depends on packet geometry
A.domain: A frozen OP001 packet on TD000/TD001 hex/Voronoi boundary carrier
A.frozen_oriented_D6_behavior: invariant under frozen oriented-D6 action (orientation-restored reflections)
A.homogeneity_scale_dimension: area-like, degree 2 in carrier length unit before fixed-lattice unitization
A.input_packet_object: oriented-D6 packet polyline with k boundary edges and endpoint chord
A.name: SIGNED_BULGE_DENSITY
A.normalization: divide by packet edge count k
A.numerator: A2 = exact lattice-determinant shoelace sum of packet polyline closed by endpoint chord
A.orientation_convention: signed with frozen oriented boundary convention
A.plain_path_reversal_behavior: signed shoelace numerator changes sign if orientation is reversed without orientation restoration
A.sign_convention: positive/negative encodes bulge side relative to oriented endpoint chord

G.frozen_oriented_D6_behavior: task-relative carrier invariant/equivariant under frozen orientation convention
G.homogeneity_scale_dimension: area-like, degree 2 in embedded contour length unit
G.input_packet_object: oriented contour packet with endpoint chord
G.name: SIGNED_LOCAL_AREA_PER_EDGE
G.normalization: per-edge (divide by packet edge count k)
G.orientation_convention: signed with frozen G oriented contour convention
G.plain_path_reversal_behavior: signed local area changes sign under unrepaired orientation reversal
G.sign_convention: positive/negative local bulge side relative to oriented chord

operators.exact_role_statement: Both are signed chord-closure area densities per packet edge; raw numerical equality is not frozen because carriers and area units differ.

A.dependence_on_k: through turn-word length m; normalized by m-1
A.name: RUN_SWITCH_DENSITY
A.normalization: turn-word adjacency count normalized by m-1
A.orientation_convention: turn-sign word under frozen A convention
A.reversal_behavior: even under reversal of the turn word
A.sign_convention: nonnegative; fitted coefficient carries correction sign
A.zero_set: no adjacent turn-sign switch (including the short-word convention)

G.dependence_on_k: through both run normalization and packet/chord geometry
G.frozen_oriented_D6_behavior: invariant under frozen G carrier convention
G.homogeneity_scale_dimension: length-like if chord defect is in contour-length units
G.name: RUN_SWITCH_WEIGHTED_CHORD_DEFECT
G.normalization: run-switch density multiplied by frozen G chord-defect amplitude
G.orientation_convention: turn/run structure plus reversal-invariant chord defect
G.sign_convention: nonnegative generator for ordinary positive chord defect; fitted coefficient is negative in frozen Stage D/E

operators.exact_role_statement: Both encode run/turn alternation, but G gates/weights it by geometric chord defect while A does not.

strongest_stage_b0_conclusion: SIGNED_BULGE/AREA shares the same signed chord-closure-area-density role with carrier normalization mismatch; run structure is not the same operator because G contains chord-defect weighting absent from A.
